chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: Web pages are filled with a C of words.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: If all the words look the same, your readers could get lost or worse bored.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: In order to spice up the page and keep readers engaged, you should use HTML headings.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: HTML headings make titles and subtitles stand out in the C of words on a web page.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: Here's what a page looks like without headings.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: Here's what it looks like with headings.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: You can see now why headings are a must.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: They appear bigger and with more space, the normal paragraphs.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: There are six different heading levels.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: The levels range from H1 to H6 and each heading level has a rank.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: H1 is the largest and most important heading.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: H2 is the second and on and on to H6, which is the least important heading.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: Each HTML heading has a default size.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: You can change the size with the style attribute using the CSS font size property.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: And to change the color of the heading, you can use the CSS color property.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: Headings are important for many reasons.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: People often skim a page by its headings.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: This way, they can go right to the information they need.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: Search engines use the headings to index the structure and content of your web pages.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: See, the search result shows the heading from the page.

chunks.title: Headings
chunks.text: If you want to engage your readers and get indexed properly, be sure to use headings correctly.
